sources.entry: Touch Emoji - Emoji picker for MacBook Pro Touch Bar.

summary.one_liner: Touch Emoji is a macOS app that puts an emoji picker on the MacBook Pro Touch Bar, inserting the tapped emoji into the currently open window.
summary.what_it_does: Launching the app adds an icon to the Control Strip on the Touch Bar. Tapping that icon opens a swipeable panel of emojis. Touching an emoji on the panel inserts it into whichever window is currently open. The README is short and includes a demo reference, but it does not describe settings, emoji categories, or implementation details. Installation is done by downloading a release from GitHub, unpacking it, and moving the app into Applications. The README also notes that the app is based on touch-bar-emojis by Gabriel Lorin.
use_cases: insert emoji on a MacBook Pro Touch Bar
pick emojis quickly from the Touch Bar
add emoji to documents without a keyboard emoji menu
emoji input on macOS Control Strip
how_to_run: Download the latest release from GitHub
Move 'Touch Emoji' to the Applications folder
Launch the app to add its icon to the Control Strip
If emoji touch does not work, enable TouchEmoji under System Preferences → Security and Privacy → Privacy → Accessibility
notable: Lives in the Control Strip on the Touch Bar, opened by tapping its icon
Swipeable emoji panel shown on the Touch Bar
Inserts the touched emoji into the currently open window
Derived from touch-bar-emojis by Gabriel Lorin
caveats: Requires a MacBook Pro with a Touch Bar
Needs Accessibility permission granted in macOS Security and Privacy settings for emoji insertion to work
README does not state a license or describe ongoing maintenance
